نتشامخ (form VI)
# نَتَشَامَخُ (natašāmaḵu) /na.ta.ʃaː.ma.xu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَشَامَخَ (tašāmaḵa)
# نَتَشَامَخَ (natašāmaḵa) /na.ta.ʃaː.ma.xa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَشَامَخَ (tašāmaḵa)
# نَتَشَامَخْ (natašāmaḵ) /na.ta.ʃaː.max/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَشَامَخَ (tašāmaḵa)
